title: Priority Commitment Ladder for Strategic Partners
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Problem: High-touch customers and strategic partners currently surface roadmap requests and escalations via a mix of support tickets, AE threads, and executive asks. There is no deterministic gate or SLA for response/commitment, which causes: inconsistent follow-through, downstream engineering context loss, and difficulty quantifying commitment against roadmap OKRs.

Goal: Create a repeatable "Priority Commitment Ladder" (PCL) that maps inbound signals from strategic accounts to a deterministic intake, scoring, routing, and commitment outcome. The PCL will allow us to: prioritize tradeoffs against OKRs, set predictable SLAs for initial response and decision, and escalate to a formal commitment path when warranted (roadmap consideration, dedicated workstream, or contractual deliverable).

Scope:
- Build an intake schema and scoring rubric that Support/AE/Solutions can use for all high-touch accounts.
- Add a lightweight intake form template and training doc.
- Implement a small routing automation that assigns an initial PM owner + Solutions Eng for triage.
- Dashboard (Console) showing queue, scores, time-to-decision, and conversion to commitment.
- Pilot the flow with top-10 strategic partners for one quarter.

Out of scope (for this ticket): contractual/legal negotiation, SLA-backed financial commitments, or deep engineering changes (these will spawn follow-ups).
acceptance_criteria:
1) Intake form in Confluence + Intake route in Support is live and linkable.
2) Scoring rubric published and tested with 5 AEs.
3) Routing automation (simple webhook or Zapier -> PM/Ops) assigns an owner within SLA.
4) Pilot dashboard shows all pilot intake events and basic metrics (TTR, score, disposition).
5) Pilot commits documented decisions for > 8 of 10 accounts and retro notes captured.
rollout_plan:
Phase 1 (pilot, weeks 1-8): onboard 10 accounts, train AEs/Support, run weekly triage, capture decisions.
Phase 2 (expand, weeks 9-16): refine rubric, add top-50 accounts, integrate routing into Console.
Phase 3 (operationalize, weeks 17-24): add SLA tracking to PM cadence, add 'commitment' flag to roadmap planning templates, feed signals into OKR tracking.
risks:
- Over-indexing on vocal accounts that don't move metrics (false positives).
- Routing automation adds overhead if owners are unclear.
- Engineering capacity may be underestimated when PCL triggers a commit.
